resources.string: Changes the target frame rate to the chosen value, up from 30 FPS (KR1, KR2, KR3) or 30/60 FPS depending on device (KR5, KR6).

The frame rate the game will run at. NOTE: The game will slow down if it cannot run at the target FPS, make sure that your display Hz supports the chosen value, and to disable battery optimizations that lower it. The map screen always runs at 60 FPS.
